title: Victoria BC Travel Vlog 🌿 | Slow & Cozy Weekend on Vancouver Island – Café Hopping, Sunsets & Ocean
description:
✨ Come spend a slow and cozy weekend with me on Vancouver Island 🌿 — from sipping lattes in Victoria’s cafés to wandering antique shops in Sidney, catching golden sunsets by the water, and taking peaceful ferry rides. This travel vlog is all about soft summer vibes, slowing down, and finding comfort in the little moments.
We started the trip on the ferry across shimmering waters, arriving in Sidney BC — a charming seaside town filled with cozy cafés, antique shops, and little finds. I tried a lavender elderflower lemonade that felt like summer in a sip. 🍋✨
In Victoria BC, golden hour painted the city before we explored Market Square, wandered Fan Tan Alley in Chinatown, and had warm bowls of ramen before ending the night with ice cream under pink skies. 🌸🌅
The next day was slower: fish & chips at Fisherman’s Wharf, lattes at a vintage-inspired coffee shop, browsing Belle General Store for knick-knacks, and finding whimsical treasures at Paboom while strolling through bookstores. 📚💛

If you love cozy lifestyle vlogs, cinematic travel diaries, or The Summer I Turned Pretty vibes, this one’s for you.
